Title: Jehoiakim Burns Jeremiah's Scroll
DateApprox: c. 605-604 BC (fourth and fifth years of Jehoiakim)
KeyPersons: Jeremiah; Baruch; Jehoiakim, King of Judah; Gemariah, Son of Shaphan
Events: Baruch writes Jeremiah's words on a scroll and reads them in the temple; after the princes warn the king, Jehoiakim cuts the scroll with a penknife and burns it leaf by leaf in the winter fire, and Jeremiah dictates the scroll again with many more words added.
